sages.name: WRAPPERSAGE
sages.notes: Mirrors the default codex adapter: command[0] is built from {MAGI_SCRIPTS_DIR} so the sage only runs if the placeholder resolves to the real scripts directory. cli is 'sh' because preflight checks cli on PATH, not command[0] — the same split the real BALTHASAR uses, where cli is 'codex' while command[0] is the bundled wrapper.
